title: Open Frequency scene 002 — water tower catwalk night
source_description: Intended Story 169 source brief for the water-tower scene; candidate frames are measured against it and never define it.
summary_reference: At night on a wind-lashed water-tower catwalk above a mostly dark town, Aria braces a lantern while Noah clamps a portable antenna to a rusted rail; they work with a receiver and react with relief when contact is made.
continuity_notes: The same two people, portable antenna, receiver, and lantern remain visually coherent across the submitted frames.
The action stays on the elevated water-tower catwalk above the mostly dark town.
